dtn_modes.side_indices: derive from live ordered carrier entries and mode_identity.side; never assume contiguous ordering

execution.preparation: capture at most 3 already-created CellPortTerms after normal generation and before local matrix insertion; no tensor, carrier, mesh, or global matrix rebuild
execution.fallback: any unavailable input, failed child, insufficient selection coverage, failed numeric gate, or failed CPU evidence keeps same live matrix on serial port assembly

acceptance.cpu_evidence: thread readback plus process CPU/wall ratio and observed native OpenBLAS worker-thread CPU activity
acceptance.production_callback: exactly once; failure after callback begins propagates without retry
acceptance.prepared_and_terminal_receipts: separate immutable files bound by hash

runtime_identity_requirements.source_sha: derive from the final frozen source checkout at launch
runtime_identity_requirements.worker_sha256: derive from the exact executed worker file
runtime_identity_requirements.launcher_sha256: derive from the exact authorized launcher
runtime_identity_requirements.resolved_input_sha256: derive from the actual resolved input packet
runtime_identity_requirements.mesh_sha256: derive from the live mesh geometry and connectivity
runtime_identity_requirements.carrier_mode_manifest_sha256: derive from the live ordered carrier manifest
runtime_identity_requirements.comparison_sha256: derive from the completed comparison receipt
